credit.credit-words: Live Out Thy Life Within Me
WORDS: Frances R. Havergal. MUSIC: “Aurelia”; Samuel S. Wesley, pub.1864. Public Domain.

If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him. Jn. 14:23 Hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us. 1 Jn. 3:24
